'''2013 Worlds Day 2 Schwartz DS Wookiee Slaving Operation''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Matt Schmaltz]] at [[2013 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Name as written on the Day 2 sheet.

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Wookiee Slaving Operation / Indentured To The Empire|VB8-D-wookieeslavingoperation-pre.gif}}
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
